PUBLIC COMMENT NOTICE:
Anyone wishing to speak during the public comment portion of a Vance County Board of Elections meeting must sign up no later than 12:00 noon on the day of the scheduled meeting. Requests to speak received after the deadline may not be accepted.
We meet on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month at 4:00 PM in the Board of Elections at the Henry A. Dennis Building. Meetings will be held at the Vance County Board of Elections office located at 300 S. Garnett Street, Henderson, NC. Anyone needing additional information may contact the Vance County Board of Elections 252-492-3730.

Voter Registration
Qualifications to Register to Vote in Vance County
To register to vote In Vance County, you must:
https://www.ncsbe.gov/registering/how-register
1. Be a citizen of the United States
2. Be a resident of Vance County, North Carolina, for 30 days before the election in which you intend to vote
3. Be 18 years of age or older by next general election day
4. Not be serving a felony sentence, including any period of probation, post-release supervision, or parole.
How to Register
Register to Vote Online Through the DMV
If you are a DMV customer with an NC driver’s license or DMV-issued ID, you may register to vote or change certain parts of your registration online. You may use this service to register, update your address, and update your party affiliation. You may not change your name.
Register online.
Print a Voter Registration Form
Complete the
Voter Registration Form (PDF)
and return it to our office. If you are a new registrant in Vance County, we need the original form (sent via mail or drop off at our office). If you are already registered in Vance County and are making updates to your information, the form can be returned by
email
or
fax.
Changes to My Registration
There are several ways an existing voter can make changes to their voter registration record.
• Address and party changes may be made online through the
DMV.
• Make changes on your voter registration card and mail it back to our office.
• Complete a
Voter Registration Application (PDF
) and return it by
mail, email, or fax.
Curbside Voting
The Vance County Board of Elections is committed to ensuring that every eligible voter has access to the voting process.
Curbside voting is available at every early voting site and on Election Day for voters who are unable to enter the voting place without physical assistance because of age, a physical disability, or physical barriers encountered at the voting site, as provided by North Carolina law.
How Curbside Voting Works
Drive to the designated curbside voting area and park in the marked curbside space. As you enter the designated curbside parking space, drive over the curbside alert sensor (curbside bell). The sensor will automatically notify election officials that a voter has arrived and is requesting curbside voting assistance.
An election official will come to your vehicle to verify your eligibility for curbside voting, administer the required curbside oath, and provide any required documentation.
Your ballot will be brought to your vehicle so you can vote privately. After you have completed your ballot, the election official will return it to the voting enclosure and securely cast it.
Curbside voters have the same voting rights and may receive the same authorized assistance as voters who vote inside the polling place.
If you have questions about curbside voting or need additional assistance, please contact the Vance County Board of Elections at
(252) 492-3730
or visit our office at
300 S. Garnett Street, Suite C, Henderson, NC 27536.
